metadata.description: Small, free mods that make long Claude Code sessions cheaper and easier to read.

plugins.name: brain-dump
plugins.description: Turns a long, messy prompt into a clear four-part prompt before it is sent.

plugins.name: cache-clock
plugins.description: Countdown to a cold prompt cache, with an optional keep-warm ping.

plugins.name: chat-handoff
plugins.description: Writes a detailed handoff prompt for a fresh chat and starts it when you click.

plugins.name: chat-inventory
plugins.description: Side panel "In this chat": to-do with goal, connectors with call counts, skills, files read and created. No model calls.

plugins.name: helper-desk
plugins.description: Live task bar and one card per subagent. No model calls.

plugins.name: reflect
plugins.description: Notices a lasting rule in your prompt and asks where to save it. Nothing is saved without your choice.

plugins.name: screen-share
plugins.description: Type /screen-share before you record: names, emails, phone numbers and money amounts show as grey bars. Claude still reads the real text.
